description: Land Acquisition - Vaharai, Koralaipatthu - North, Batticaloa District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It involves the Minister directing the taking of immediate possession of a specific land parcel, including detailed description of the land (location, boundaries, extent). The core subject matter is land/property acquisition, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4). While it mentions a government minister, the focus is on the land acquisition action rather than government structure or personnel changes.
